description: This Java class, GetCreditReportCommandHandler, is a Spring service that handles commands to get credit reports within the Fineraft project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, delegates the processing to CreditReportWritePlatformService, and is designated for the CREDITREPORT entity with GET action.

classes.name: GetCreditReportCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service that handles credit report retrieval commands by delegating to the credit report service.

methods.name: GetCreditReportCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the CreditReportWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to retrieve a credit report by calling the service.
